title: Burst Tomato Caprese Pasta
description: Cherry tomatoes cooked down into a quick garlicky sauce, tossed with pasta, mozzarella and basil.

steps.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the pasta until al dente, 10 to 11 minutes. Save ½ cup of the pasta water, then drain.
Meanwhile, warm the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the garlic and pepper flakes and cook until the garlic is just turning golden, 1 to 2 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and a pinch of salt. Cook, stirring, until most of them burst and turn saucy, 6 to 8 minutes. Press any stubborn ones with your spoon.
Add the pasta and a splash of the pasta water and toss. Take the pan off the heat and fold in the mozzarella and basil so the cheese softens but doesn’t fully melt.
Season with black pepper and finish with parmesan.
